title: DCAP Points v2 — Owner Registry (PRIVATE, UNINSTALLED)
sourceJournal: Existing N5 Real Award Journal, read-only and immutable
ownerPolicy: OWNER_FINAL: user's explicit final chat instruction replaces future committee approval

tabs.name: N5 Public Members
tabs.note: Append owner-final new identities or owner-approved display-name changes. Existing 37 historical public IDs stay in frozen r000; a memberId must remain stable.

tabs.name: N5 Events
tabs.note: Register additional public event IDs, including commander events not in existing rules.

tabs.name: N5 Rule Versions
tabs.note: Append prospective point changes. Do not overwrite previous awards. Never set a default other-commander rule.

tabs.name: N5 Owner Awards
tabs.note: Append future owner-final awards; for an Other Commander use roleId=other-commander, awardType=OWNER_MANUAL_OTHER_COMMANDER and leave ruleId and ruleVersionId blank. Pending manual points are PENDING_OWNER_POINTS and excluded from publication.

otherCommander: For Commander contribution without applicable event-specific commander rule, always ask the owner for an individual positive integer. Do not reuse any previous Other Commander amount.
cumulativeData: Frozen r000 plus 60 existing approved N5 journal rows plus newer owner-final awards in the separate registry workbook.
privileges: Read-only public API connects to both private Sheets; a separate authenticated owner-only writer is still required to submit changes.
